{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dress: A-line midi dress with long sleeves, a softly rounded neckline and a defined waist, hem just below the knee, deep forest green #2E5A4C, matte crepe with a slight drape

Tights: sheer, 20 denier, warm nude #D8A98C, fine knit

Pumps: closed-toe, almond toe, 6 cm block heel, dark taupe-brown #6B4A3A, smooth suede

Clutch: small structured envelope clutch with a thin chain, dark taupe-brown #6B4A3A, matte leather

Earrings: small drop earrings with a polished finish, soft gold #C9A24B, metal

Coat: single-breasted straight coat, knee length, camel #B98E62, wool-cashmere blend

Why it works: A knee-to-midi dress in a deep, rich green is the classic choice for a festive family dinner at a restaurant. It is dressy enough for the occasion without trying to outshine the guest of honor. The covered shoulders and arms, the modest neckline and the moderate hem keep the look graceful and respectful, so there is little for anyone to remark on. The green picks up the grey-green of your eyes and sits well with your warm skin and golden hair.
